name: Key Girl
storyline: One day while Kagi was walking, she fell into a random hole in the ground! She fell for hours and hours, before finally hitting the ground and realizing she was in Lock-Land! Now she has to collect 10 spheres in 10 mazes, while avoiding Dunnies, to get out!
summary:
Follow Kagi as you try to get through Lock Land. Try your hardest to get the high score, and beat my score of 10! Find easter eggs, and not much else... " - A synopsis of the games plot from the official Itch.io page of the game.

Released June 28th, 2024, Key Girl is a short arcade styled game inspired by games like 'Pac-Man'. The game consists of 10 maze like levels, with 10 spheres in each level. You have to get through each level as your player character, Kagi, while avoiding Dunnys. There are many bonus modes (accessible through the ESC Key while in game) to the game to spice up the experience, such as the 'Golden Bunny Mode' Which spawns in the Golden Dunny to chase you around the maze.
